description: Authoritative schema for the PBuddy 6-pass pipeline. Lists the raw artifacts produced by each pass, the settings the user can adjust in each pass's web view, and the dependency graph describing which upstream raw artifacts and settings are inputs to each raw artifact.

conventions.artifact_path: All artifact paths are relative to data/projects/<project_id>/passes/pass{N}/raw/
conventions.frame_numbers: Frame numbers stored in artifacts use OpenCV 0-based indexing unless noted as browser frame numbers (OpenCV + 1)

dependency_types.source_video: The original uploaded video file at uploads/original.mp4
dependency_types.artifact: A raw artifact produced by an earlier pass; fields: pass, file
dependency_types.setting: A user-editable value from an earlier pass's web view; fields: pass, name

medians/median_NNN.png.description: Pixel-wise median of every 10th frame in each consecutive 5-second chunk; NNN is the zero-padded chunk index. The midpoint_chunk index (from result.json) identifies the chunk used for court corner alignment.

result.json.description: Background image dimensions (bg_width, bg_height), median_count, midpoint_chunk index, and video_fps

court_corners.description: Pixel coordinates of the four court corners in the distorted background image; user drags handles in the SVG overlay editor

k1.description: Radial distortion coefficient for single-term division model: r_u = r_d / (1 + K1 * r_d²); negative for barrel, positive for pincushion

single_channel.png.description: Single-channel image derived from the Pass 0 midpoint median (V − S/2 in HSV space); used for near-baseline court outline tracking

result.json.description: Image dimensions (bg_width, bg_height), median chunk index used, and sample point pairs (sx,sy)→(px1,py1)/(px2,py2) along the near baseline in distorted image space

tent_mask.png.description: Binary mask (white = inside court volume silhouette, black = outside) derived by projecting the Pass 0 court geometry onto the background plate; used by Pass 3 and Pass 4 as a detection mask

result.json.description: Video FPS and frame dimensions (bg_width, bg_height); metadata needed to drive the annotation UI

annotations.json.description: Per-frame ball annotations submitted by the user: { "annotations": { "<browser_frame_number>": { x, y, radius } } }

rally.json.description: Rally records and player names submitted by the user: { "rally": [...], "player_names": {...} }

patches/raw/NNNNNN.png.description: 64×64 px crop of the source video frame centred on the annotated ball; filename is the browser frame number zero-padded to 6 digits; uploaded from the browser during annotation

patches/bg_sub/NNNNNN.png.description: Background-subtracted version of the corresponding raw patch (cv2.absdiff of raw patch and the matching crop from the median background plate); missing if the median background image is unavailable

ball_annotations.description: Per-frame ball position and radius; keys are browser frame numbers (OpenCV frame index + 1); user clicks the video frame to place each annotation

rally_records.description: Ordered list of rallies; each entry records the frame range, opening score string (e.g. '7-5-2'), which player is serving, which is receiving, and whether the serving team wins the rally

player_names.description: Four player names establishing initial team membership and court positions at the start of the game; used to build the score overlay in Pass 6

result.json.description: annotation_count, ball_pixel_count, min_ball_radius, max_ball_radius; annotation_count=0 signals that no annotations were found and the mask must be borrowed from another project

ball_colors.csv.description: R, G, B, H, S, V channel values sampled from pixels within the annotated ball patches; one row per sampled pixel across all annotated frames

HSVmask.npz.description: 48×48×8 H×S×V boolean array (key 'mask') marking bins that contain at least one ball pixel; used by Pass 4 for colour-based ball candidate filtering

HSVmask.png.description: 2×4 grid of H×S subplots (one per V bin) showing signal-present HSV bins; cells coloured by HSV midpoint, dots mark bins with at least one ball pixel

detections.json.description: Per-frame candidate ball detections restricted to frames inside recorded rally bounds; each detection records frame (OpenCV index), cx, cy, radius, area, and perimeter; also records stable frame range, total in-rally frame count, and max observed ball radius

detections_map.png.description: Binary image at tent-mask resolution; white pixel at every detection centre; useful for inspecting the spatial distribution of all detections across the full video

patches/NNNNNN.png.description: 64×64 px composite diagnostic patch for each annotated frame; R=motion, G=color, B=tent, M=!color, C=!motion; frame number is the browser frame number (OpenCV + 1), zero-padded to 6 digits

segments.json.description: Trajectory segments built by linking Pass 4 detections across small gaps; each segment records id, first_frame, last_frame, detection count (length), mean_speed_px_per_frame, and the list of per-frame detections (frame, cx, cy, radius); also records algorithm parameters: max_gap_frames, large_gate_px, small_gate_px, min_segment_length, min_mean_speed_px_per_frame

deleted_segment_ids.description: Integer IDs of segments the user has marked for removal as false positives; removed from the accepted segments.json before Pass 6 reads it

export.mp4.description: Highlight reel MP4 (H.264 CRF 18, slow preset, yuv420p); contains all rallies in order, each bracketed by cross-fade transitions to/from the nearest median background; score/player-name overlay is composited at full opacity throughout and transitions smoothly at rally boundaries; yellow ball-trail overlay shows Pass 5 segment detections in a 1-second trailing window (opacity 5%–80%, lineWidth 1–6 px); audio is spliced sample-accurately with per-rally fade-in/out (AAC 192k); MP4 chapter markers correspond to rally start times

result.json.description: Rally count, total output duration in seconds, and a YouTube-pasteable chapter timestamp string (e.g. '0:00 0-0-2\n0:45 1-0-1\n…')

chapters.ffmeta.description: FFMETADATA1-format chapter definition file consumed by ffmpeg during the final audio/chapter mux step; chapter titles are rally score strings; timings are derived from rally frame counts divided by source FPS
